title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Recovery Standard — Grounds for Reversal and Member Repayments
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders (Cascade Ortho Rider family): when an orthodontic payment is reversed or repaid.**

## Grounds

For every person:

- a payment is reversed for its full amount when it was issued for a service period beginning after the rider termination date, or when it duplicates a payment for the same case and service period;
- a payment is reversed for the excess only when it took the person's lifetime benefits above the maximum.

In addition, for a person whose current rider is the only Cascade orthodontic rider the person has held, when a case's latest establishment entry is a takeover entry and the payments made to the member on the case exceed what that takeover makes payable to date:

- the member returns the excess;
- the return is recorded as a reversal of the case's initial payment, and is never more than that payment;
- a case paid to a practice is recovered from the practice by offset.

The amount a member repays on a case is not fixed until the case's latest establishment entry is a takeover entry whenever the case's appliances were placed before its waiting period ended.

Put the other way, for a case banded before its waiting period ended, while its latest establishment entry is not a takeover entry the member's repayment is not yet fixed.

## How the repayment is recorded

The repayment is recorded against the case's initial payment, keeping that payment's installment position, service period and payee.

## The member's repayment tool: `repay_ortho_overpayment_ce1ed3cf`

Paying back an overpayment is the member's own act. The agent unlocks the tool `repay_ortho_overpayment_ce1ed3cf` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the member) runs it.

One call records the member's repayment as a reversal of the stated orthodontic payment for the stated amount, dated today. It keeps that payment's case, installment position, service period and payee, and takes the amount off the orthodontic benefit paid under the rider. The member can see the repayment in the case payment history.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `original_ortho_payment_id` | reference number of the orthodontic payment the repayment is recorded against, as returned by the orthodontic payment lookup and read out by the agent | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount the member repays | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded half up to the cent; recorded as given |

**Receipt.** A successful call returns:

- the reference of the repayment entry (`reversal`);
- the case number;
- the amount;
- the payment date;
- the orthodontic benefit paid under the rider after the repayment.

A receipt carrying a reversal reference means the repayment was recorded.
